question: What will be Solana's (SOL) closing price on August 4, 2026?

model.prompt_context: This market resolves based on the closing price of Solana (SOL) for August 4, 2026, as reported in the "Close" column of the CoinGecko Solana Price History page (coingecko.com/en/coins/solana/historical_data) for the row dated 2026-08-04 (UTC daily close). Bands are inclusive of the lower bound and exclusive of the upper bound; for example, a close of exactly $74.00 resolves to the $74.00–$75.50 band.
